corrections.text: The headline, summary and body say, citing The New Stack, that Grok API text watermarking is now opt-in, enabled per model by team admins. The Herald also read SpaceXSI's current documentation (docs.x.ai, Output Watermarking page, November 13), which says text watermarking is off by default and that team admins can turn it on per model, and adds that 'Some models may be locked on for your team' and cannot be turned off from the Console. The New Stack does not mention locked models and the article does not say that opt-in does not necessarily apply to every model for every team.
